title: Assassin's Creed studios lose 166 jobs at Ubisoft
subject: ubisoft
description:
What do you think this means for Assassin's Creed? 👇

Ubisoft is cutting 166 positions across Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Quebec, the studios behind many Assassin's Creed games. Ubisoft says production needs are changing as its portfolio evolves.

Sources: Gematsu (Nov 19, 2026), IGN (via Gematsu)

scenes.text: Ubisoft is cutting 166 jobs in Canada.
The cuts land at Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Quebec, two studios at the heart of Assassin's Creed.
Ubisoft confirmed the layoffs on November 19 and said its production needs are changing as the portfolio evolves.
A source told IGN the affected staff were on projects that got canceled or refocused, or couldn't be moved to another team.
Ubisoft says everyone affected will get severance, extended health benefits and career transition services.
